text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno Muteki could not win the Satsuki 
Sho. She lamented her own inexperience.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno Muteki lays bare her frustration. 
She vows to win next time and prove that 
the path she has walked was never a 
mistake.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Classic Triple Crown races have only 
just begun. The next goal is the Japanese 
Derby!
